text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High error rate detected in prod-edge (5xx surge) — 15% 5xx over 5m. Alerting oncall.

alice_chen: I'm on it, paging the SRE rotation. any idea region/cluster?

maria_ops: seeing spike from eu-west-1 ingress pool (ingress-pool-eu-rt). Metrics show TLS handshake failures increasing ~10:02 UTC.

rajiv_s: logs from gateway show repeated: "tls: handshake failure: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid" for client connections to upstream.

alice_chen: can someone grep the proxy logs for the exact subject?

ingress-svc: pasted snippet from gateway logs: ```
2026-03-14T10:01:58Z proxy[envoy]: [warning] TLS handshake error: x509: certificate has expired
2026-03-14T10:02:01Z proxy[envoy]: client_cn=svc-client-123 subject=/CN=svc-client-123 issuer=/CN=redwood-intermediate-2024 notBefore=2023-03-15 notAfter=2026-03-14
```

alice_chen: huh — intermediate CA seems to have expired today at 2026-03-14. That would explain mass mTLS failures.

daniel_k: I'm pulling the secret in eu cluster: ```kubectl -n redwood get secret ingress-client-ca -o yaml``` — looks like the cert in `ca.crt` has not rotated.

maria_ops: was there a scheduled rotation? I recall a rotation PR targeted last week but it didn't land for eu.

rajiv_s: quick impact calc: ~12% of total connections in eu are failing TLS, resulting in ~8% increase in 5xx seen by customers routed through eu nodes. Two paying customers had increased error rates on their dedicated endpoints (IDs redwood-coa, beta-analytics).

alice_chen: mitigation options: 1) update secret with new CA cert from vault and rollout, 2) temporarily disable mTLS enforcement on affected ingress pool (risk: reduces auth guarantees), 3) route traffic away from eu to other regions (capacity permitting).

daniel_k: I'd prefer to patch the secret and reload proxies quickly. do we have the new intermediate cert ready in vault?

maria_ops: yes, cert `redwood-intermediate-2026` is in vault. I can fetch and push to k8s.

alice_chen: do it. steps please in thread so handoff is clear.

maria_ops: executing: ```
# fetch cert from vault
vault kv get -format=json secret/certs/redwood-intermediate-2026 | jq -r .data.data.crt > /tmp/redwood-intermediate-2026.crt
# update secret in eu cluster
kubectl -n redwood create secret generic ingress-client-ca --from-file=ca.crt=/tmp/redwood-intermediate-2026.crt -o yaml --dry-run=client | kubectl apply -f -
# restart ingress daemonset pods to pick up new secret
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart daemonset/ingress-proxy-eu
```

alice_chen: rolling restart now. will watch readiness and error rate.

ingress-svc: restart triggered for 6 pods; health checks show pods becoming READY one-by-one.

(alice_chen reacts :eyes:)

10 minutes later

maria_ops: restart finished, all pods READY. tailing logs — no further x509 expiry messages.

rajiv_s: metrics: 5xx back down from 15% -> 2.1% over last 3m. customer error dashboards show recovery for both affected customers.

alice_chen: good. confirm we didn't bypass any auth: mTLS enforcement remained enabled; we rotated CA and reloaded. :white_check_mark:

daniel_k: I'm taking over the oncall handoff in 15m. notes: root cause — expiration of intermediate CA cert that was scheduled to be rotated but PR didn't land for eu. mitigation — rotated secret with new intermediate and restarted ingress to pick up cert. customer impact — transient 5xx (peak ~12% EU traffic), two customers saw errors (~1–5% request loss window).

alice_chen: leaving context for daniel_k: check PR backlog for cert rotations, verify automation for cross-region rotations, and confirm we have monitoring alert to warn 30 days before CA expiry.

daniel_k: oncall acknowledged, will follow up. scheduling a quick postmortem meeting 0900 UTC tomorrow with platform + sec to review: rotation automation gaps, runbook clarity, and customer communication.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by alice_chen and daniel_k.

alice_chen: outgoing handoff: i'm closing the active paging channel; elevating to incident report. tagging product and support to surface to affected customers.

maria_ops: added short-term mitigation task to infra board and created follow-up ticket #INF-3721 for automation of cross-region cert rotation.

rajiv_s: quick note for postmortem: include exact cert subject/issuer and why PR didn't deploy to eu (merge conflict + missing pipeline trigger).

alice_chen: thanks team. reopening if we see any regression. :heavy_check_mark:
